title: WeaponSwap selector owner and exemptions

leads.title: WeaponSwap selector owner and exemptions
leads.summary: The WeaponSwap selector 7727fe65-6ddd-4d10-aeb8-e2d1e59c9054 appears in exactly one of 109,593 captured raw and XML files (WM_WeaponSwap itself, as a list member), so it has no captured owner, unlike the Killshot selector whose owner U_Ability_Killshot exists. The import counts reproduce (60 of 63 weapon bodies, not CZ3A1, DB-12, Vz. 61) and the three exempt bodies differ from the members only by that import and weapon-specific assets; no shared structural property explains the exemption. The modifier is a uniform +1 draw step, so weapon comparisons among the 60 do not change.
leads.reopenWhen: Reopen if the owner of the selector 7727fe65 is captured, or native swap or equip behavior shows which weapons activate it.
searched: Little-endian GUID and text scan of 109,593 captured raw EBX and XML overlay files under builds/1.4.3.0/capture and xml: one hit, WM_WeaponSwap (raw and XML) itself; the Killshot selector control has its owner in U_Ability_Killshot XML
Coverage ledger routes containing weaponswap or swap: only WM_WeaponSwap, a HUD property listener, UI/audio configs and an AI action tag; no selector owner

Import sets of the 41 weapon bodies with pinned release import data: exempt CZ3A1, DB-12 and Vz. 61 lack only WM_WeaponSwap among the common imports; Client_Schematic imports occur on 40 of the weapons with import data, so they do not discriminate

First worker (Luna xhigh, 28.4 min) reproduced the L109 import counts (WM_WeaponSwap 60 of 63; WM_Killshot on the six Sniper Rifles) and stopped at an owner control that pinned evidence could not settle

assets.question: Which asset owns the WeaponSwap selector 7727fe65-6ddd-4d10-aeb8-e2d1e59c9054, and what does the modifier hold?
assets.conclusion: WM_WeaponSwap holds one draw step (Class_4aac041b Field_9540bd8e = +1, i32 at offset 216) and lists the selector GUID as a member; no captured asset owns that GUID.

question: Who owns and consumes the WeaponSwap selector, and why do CZ3A1, DB-12 and Vz. 61 lack the modifier?
sourceFacts: Raw re-read (scripts/frosty-raw-check.py): WM_WeaponSwap i32 at offset 216 = 1 (bytes 01000000), sha256 d5e27f4e...
The selector GUID occurs only inside WM_WeaponSwap (raw and XML) across 109,593 captured raw and XML files; the Killshot selector has an owner, U_Ability_Killshot.
Worker reproduction of L109: WM_WeaponSwap on 60 of 63 site weapon bodies, absent on cz3a1, db12, vz61; WM_Killshot on the six Sniper Rifles.
Among the 41 weapon bodies with pinned release import data, the three exempt bodies differ from the members only by WM_WeaponSwap and weapon-specific assets.
inference: The modifier is a uniform one-tier draw step whose selector is defined outside the captured data. The exemption has no visible structural cause.
unresolved: Owner and activation of the selector; whether it applies to equip after a swap; why three weapons are exempt.
siteImpact: None: a uniform +1 deploy step on 60 weapons does not change comparisons among them; only the three exempt weapons would differ, and no activation evidence supports a site toggle.
workers: first worker gpt-6-luna xhigh 28.4 min 3.45M tokens (stopped at its owner control); conclusion drawn by the orchestrator from the scans above
